preReview.title: Emery hopes Champions League win will give Aston Villa confidence
preReview.description: Aston Villa won their Champions League opener, and they will be hoping to get on the board in the Premier League against Nottingham Forest.

preReview.title: Emery confía en que el triunfo en la Champions League refuerce la confianza del Aston Villa
preReview.description: El Aston Villa ganó en su estreno en la Champions League y buscará su primera victoria en la Premier League ante el Nottingham Forest.

preReview.title: Emery spera che il successo in Champions League dia fiducia all'Aston Villa
preReview.description: L'Aston Villa ha vinto all'esordio in Champions League e ora cerca il primo successo in Premier League contro il Nottingham Forest.

preReview.title: Emery espera que vitória na Champions dê confiança ao Aston Villa
preReview.description: O Aston Villa venceu na estreia da Liga dos Campeões e agora busca seus primeiros pontos na Premier League contra o Nottingham Forest.

preReview.title: Emery espère que la victoire en Ligue des champions rendra confiance à Aston Villa
preReview.description: Vainqueur de son premier match de Ligue des champions, Aston Villa veut débloquer son compteur en Premier League face à Nottingham Forest.

preReview.title: إيمري يأمل أن يمنح فوز دوري الأبطال أستون فيلا دفعة معنوية
preReview.description: افتتح أستون فيلا مشواره بدوري أبطال أوروبا بالفوز، ويأمل في حصد أول نقاطه بالدوري الإنجليزي أمام نوتنغهام فورست.

preReview.title: Emery hofft nach Aston Villas Champions-League-Sieg auf neues Selbstvertrauen
preReview.description: Nach dem Sieg zum Champions-League-Auftakt will Aston Villa gegen Nottingham Forest auch die ersten Premier-League-Punkte holen.

preReview.title: Emery espera que a vitória na Liga dos Campeões dê confiança ao Aston Villa
preReview.description: O Aston Villa estreou-se com uma vitória na Liga dos Campeões e procura agora o primeiro triunfo na Premier League diante do Nottingham Forest.
